gaps.rationale: Existing step-up and key controls do not specify local authentication lifecycle or platform authentication policy.
gaps.acceptance_plan: Inspect platform authentication configuration and challenge/key binding; test cancellation, failed authentication, enrollment changes and unauthorized access on an owned test device.

gaps.rationale: No dedicated minimum supported OS or security-patch policy is defined by the current mobile catalog.
gaps.acceptance_plan: Review supported Android/iOS versions against the product threat model; test behavior on supported and unsupported OS versions; document security update policy.

gaps.rationale: Controlled deployment does not establish enforcement of a minimum safe app version after release.
gaps.acceptance_plan: Inspect the signed version policy and server enforcement; test outdated versions, network failure, rollout exceptions and authorized update recovery.

gaps.rationale: Permission and SDK minimization do not establish unlinkability or separation of identity signals by purpose.
gaps.acceptance_plan: Inventory identifiers and SDK data flows; verify isolation of fraud and analytics signals using synthetic accounts and authorized traffic evidence.

gaps.rationale: Documented permission purpose is narrower than accurate user-facing disclosure of collection, retention and sharing.
gaps.acceptance_plan: Compare actual data flows, background collection and SDK sharing with privacy notices and platform declarations; record discrepancies.

gaps.rationale: Retention/deletion and permission minimization do not establish user-driven correction, consent withdrawal or renewed consent.
gaps.acceptance_plan: Exercise user data access, correction, deletion and consent withdrawal with synthetic records; inspect downstream propagation and documented exceptions.

gaps.rationale: Release hygiene and attestation signals do not prove runtime analysis resistance or define response behavior.
gaps.acceptance_plan: Review threat-model-dependent runtime integrity policy; use authorized lab instrumentation and assess detection, false positives, fail-safe behavior and server authority.
